goal: Prevent timing side channels from de-anonymizing private transaction broadcasts
Ensure initial broadcast connections finish even if transactions are returned early
agreement: General support for the concept while several nonblocking concerns remain open
ACK modulo an edge case where users cannot resend resolved transactions (vasild)
Concerned that retaining transactions in memory indefinitely increases resource usage (mzumsande)
Warns that disconnects without pong could steal retry slots from other transactions (mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it closes a timing side channel adversaries could use to de-anonymize broadcasts
Protects node operators relying on private broadcast from network-level transaction correlation
